# OfferSteady: public product information

OfferSteady is operated by 杭州临平知界智能技术工作室（个体工商户）, Hangzhou, China. The Global product is an English Web workspace and desktop Companion for interview preparation, live transcription, grounded answer guidance, typed questions, user-triggered screenshots, written assessments, and review.

## How it works

Users select a resume, job description, and optional knowledge materials for a session. The connected desktop Companion provides enabled microphone, supported computer-output audio, and user-triggered screenshot inputs. The Web workspace displays progressive transcripts and can prepare guidance manually or through optional Auto Answer for confirmed interviewer questions. Raw audio is not stored by default.

## Plans

Free: $0. Free · no recurring charge. Available on your account; the allowance is not replenished monthly. Includes: 15 minutes of realtime Copilot; 3 Screen Assist uses; One-time allowance per account; Resume/JD, knowledge base and Written Exam mode not included.
Interview Day Pass: $9.99 / 24 hours. One-time payment · no automatic renewal. 24 consecutive hours from confirmed payment, not your first session. Includes: 180 minutes of realtime Copilot; Unlimited Screen Assist; Resume and job-description context; Written Exam mode; knowledge base not included.
Pro Weekly: $49.99 / 7 days. One-time payment · no automatic renewal. 7 consecutive days from confirmed payment, not your first session. Includes: Unlimited Copilot; Unlimited Screen Assist; Resume, job-description, and knowledge materials; Written Exam mode and session review.
Pro Monthly: $99.99/month. Monthly subscription · renews automatically until cancelled. From confirmed subscription payment through the paid billing period shown in your account. Includes: Unlimited Copilot; Unlimited Screen Assist; Resume, job-description, and knowledge materials; Written Exam mode and session review.
Job Hunt: $199.99 / 90 days. One-time payment · no automatic renewal. 90 consecutive days from confirmed payment, not your first session. Includes: Unlimited Copilot; Unlimited Screen Assist; Resume, job-description, and knowledge materials; Written Exam mode and session review. Secure checkout is available for approved live plans. Sign in to choose a plan and review the final total, taxes, and billing terms before payment.

## Boundaries

AI output is guidance and can be inaccurate. Users must verify every claim, keep answers faithful to their real experience, obtain consent where required, and follow the interview organiser's rules for AI assistance, recording, screen capture, confidentiality, and external tools. Opening the website alone does not start audio or screenshot capture.
